steps.text: every branch ends REMOVE TAG → End Flow, and each Send Email step’s On bounced link leads to the same cleanup (V2): the spec carries it as onBounced, and the builder draws it (v52). A branch that just stops keeps in_flow_pack_abandon, and that person never gets another broadcast. Send a test contact down each exit before switching the flow on.

the export writes the greeting with the name rule: joe and JOE read Joe, JoAnn stays JoAnn, mcH reads McH, an empty name reads there (decision 123). The emails come from the master, so nothing is typed by hand

Email 1 links to the Pack's ThriveCart checkout. Open at un-park: a template lead offered TEMPLATELEAD5, or a Library buyer offered PACK5, would find $25 here. A pack_offer_code field, saved by the offer emails and carried on this link as library_offer_code rides Abandon: Hacks Library checkout's, would give it back.

one Pack abandon with a real inbox: the email arrives about an hour later and the contact leaves People IN FLOW. A Library abandon from the same contact goes to Abandon: Hacks Library checkout only. Then a test purchase during the wait: no email.
